headlines.title_en: Four Departments Issue Document: Financial Institutions Prohibited from Transferring Benefits to Shareholders, Strict Crackdown on 'Relying on Finance to Profit from Finance'
headlines.summary_en: [Four ministries issue document: Strictly prohibit financial institutions from transferring benefits to shareholders, investigate 'relying on finance to eat finance'] On July 31, the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the People's Bank of China, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued 'Implementation Opinions on Improving Governance of Financial Institutions' (Jinfa [2026] No. 4), proposing 22 measures across 9 parts. Dong Ximiao, chief economist of China Merchants Union and executive director of the Shanghai Finance and Development Laboratory, stated that the four ministries, from a top-level design perspective, introduced a series of measures around strengthening Party leadership, improving shareholder governance, reinforcing internal constraints, and enhancing regulatory effectiveness, systematically addressing prominent issues such as major shareholders' illegal intervention and insider control, aiming to accelerate the improvement of a modern financial enterprise system with Chinese characteristics.

headlines.title: 广发证券：地产板块估值“底背离” 核心优质房企具备长期配置价值
headlines.summary: 广发证券研报表示，地产板块估值“底背离”，核心优质房企具备长期配置价值。2026年上半年，SW地产板块累计跌16.4%，跑输大盘（沪深300）24个百分点，16家主流房企跌14.9%。当前股价中包含房价下跌预期为16%，而过去半年房价已经止跌，偏离程度达到2021年以来的最大值。短期看好板块偏离修复的反弹机会，9、10月份后若核心城市成交中枢进一步抬升，房价加速上涨，则板块具备价值反转的机会。个股选择上，短期销售增长对股价的影响依然有效，同时要兼顾企业的投资拓展表现以及估值情况。

headlines.title_en: GF Securities: Property Sector Valuation Shows 'Bottom Divergence', Core High-Quality Developers Offer Long-Term Allocation Value
headlines.summary_en: GF Securities research report says the property sector valuation shows 'divergence from fundamentals,' with core quality developers having long-term allocation value. In H1 2026, the SW property sector fell 16.4% cumulative, underperforming the broader market (CSI 300) by 24 percentage points; 16 major developers fell 14.9%. Current stock prices embed a 16% expectation of housing price declines, while home prices have already stopped falling in the past six months, with deviation reaching the largest since 2021. In the short term, opportunities for rebound from deviation repair are favored; if core city transaction volumes further rise after September-October and home prices accelerate, the sector has value reversal potential. For stock selection, short-term sales growth impact on stock prices remains effective, while also balancing companies' investment expansion performance and valuations.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title: “果链”备货旺季启幕，富士康等代工厂招工忙
headlines.summary: 进入8月，消费电子市场迎来新品发布季，以苹果新一代产品为核心驱动，整个“果链”上下游加快了“招兵买马”的节奏，为产能爬坡做足准备。记者采访了解到，与往年相比，今年的产业旺季不仅体现在一线工人的规模化招募，富士康等龙头代工厂在工程师岗位上也在不断扩充。此外，资本市场与供应链上下游，正密切关注苹果首款折叠屏手机的进展，蓝思科技、精研科技等产业龙头企业已密集进入研发攻关、产能扩建与量产交付的关键阶段。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: 'Apple Supply Chain' Peak Season Begins, Foxconn and Other Contract Manufacturers Ramp Up Hiring
headlines.summary_en: Entering August, the consumer electronics market ushers in a new product launch season, driven by Apple's new generation products, with the entire 'Apple supply chain' accelerating hiring to prepare for capacity ramping. Reports from interviews show that compared to previous years, this year's peak season is reflected not only in large-scale recruitment of frontline workers but also in continuous expansion of engineering positions at leading OEMs like Foxconn. Additionally, capital markets and supply chain players are closely watching progress on Apple's first foldable phone, with leaders like Lens Technology and Jingyan Technology entering key stages of R&D, capacity expansion, and mass production delivery. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 7月RatingDog中国服务业PMl录得50.4 连续第43个月处于扩张区间
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月5日讯，7月RatingDog中国服务业PMl录得50.4，较6月大幅回落3.7个百分点，连续第43个月处于扩张区间，但扩张速度为2024年1月以来最慢。整体来看，7月服务业扩张步伐明显放缓，但新出口业务保持韧性、就业持续扩张且成本压力缓解提供了积极支撑。7月RatingDog综合PMl产出指数录得50.8，较6月回落2.8个百分点，连续第14个月处于扩张区间，但扩张速度明显放缓。本月指数的回落主要由服务业产出增长大幅放缓所导致，制造业产出扩张速度亦有所放缓。综合就业连续第三个月保持扩张，综合投入品价格通胀进一步放缓。预计服务业及整体经济活动

headlines.title_en: July RatingDog China Services PMI at 50.4, 43rd Consecutive Month in Expansion Territory
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 5: July RatingDog China services PMI came in at 50.4, down 3.7 percentage points from June, marking the 43rd consecutive month in expansion territory, but the slowest expansion pace since January 2024. Overall, services expansion slowed notably in July, but resilience in new export business, continued employment expansion, and easing cost pressures provided positive support. The July RatingDog composite PMI output index came in at 50.8, down 2.8 percentage points from June, marking the 14th consecutive month in expansion territory, but expansion slowed notably. The decline this month was mainly driven by a sharp slowdown in services output growth, with manufacturing output expansion also slowing. headlines.title_en: ChiNext Index Turns Positive After Dropping Over 3%; STAR 50 Index Rises Over 4%
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index turned positive after earlier falling over 3%; the STAR 50 Index rose over 4%. CPO concept stocks opened lower but rallied, with Huilv Ecology, Xingwang Ruijie, Woge Optoelectronics, Kerui Technology, and Unisplendour hitting the daily limit, while Ruijie Networks surged over 13%.
